title: 1Password coordinate data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/secrets.yaml. Merged into the same template data as hosts.yaml. Names a vault and the items templates read; it cannot tell whether either exists, since only `op` knows that.

items.description: Short key -> 1Password item name. The key is what templates write (.secrets.items.mars), so renaming the item is one edit here.

fish.description: Ranged wholesale into secrets.fish — EVERY field becomes an exported var on every host.

mars.description: Read field-by-field by the caddy and quadlet env files.
